integrity: The theorem uses an analytic proof; a standard-library exact-rational checker supplies independently computed finite diagnostics, not an infinite certificate. No independent scientific audit has taken place.
scientific_limitations: Ideal single-qubit Clifford S phase gate, positive-integer i.i.d. reset gaps with finite fixed mean, equilibrium-renewal stationary initialization. No arbitrary gates, noise, adaptive clocks, finite-sample performance or pointwise convergence from synchronized reset initialization. Publication priority qualified against potentially unindexed lattice-moment optimization results.
title: Three sharp reset-budget thresholds for stationary purity of a clocked qubit
